title: IPStrategy
description: IPStrategy holds the IP strategy configuration used by Traefik to determine the client IP. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/middlewares/http/ipallowlist/#ipstrategy

depth.description: Depth tells Traefik to use the X-Forwarded-For header and take the IP located at the depth position (starting from the right).

excludedIPs.description: ExcludedIPs configures Traefik to scan the X-Forwarded-For header and select the first IP not in the list.

ipv6Subnet.description: IPv6Subnet configures Traefik to consider all IPv6 addresses from the defined subnet as originating from the same IP. Applies to RemoteAddrStrategy and DepthStrategy.
